messages:
Aria: FYI: we're coordinating a tf apply that updates the vpc routing + infra deploy role tonight during the 23:00 UTC change window. Need to avoid triggering deploybot rollbacks during release traffic shift.
Connor: What's the risky bit? routing table change or role policy swap?
Aria: Both. Plan replaces a policy statement that tightens AssumeRole rt. If a running deploy can't assume the role it'll see AssumeRoleDenied and deploy-bot will treat that like 'canary failure' and rollback.
Priya: Suggestion: version-pin the deploy role ARN in the release job to the old policy until we've verified post-apply. Then flip to new role in a controlled follow-up.
Connor: How do you mean 'version-pin'? We can't change ARNs dynamically.
Priya: Use an intermediate iam role alias in params store: infra/deploy/role-v -> points to role arn:v1. Update alias to arn:v2 only after we confirm. Deploy job reads alias.
Aria: Good idea. Minimal change to CI. We'll add terraform resources: aws_ssm_parameter for role alias plus policy update.
Connor: Throwing in a small tf snippet for audit:
```
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "deploy_role_alias" {
  name  = "/infra/deploy/role-v"
  type  = "String"
  value = aws_iam_role.deploy_role.arn
}
```
Priya: Opsflow: 1) Create new role (v2) with tightened policy 2) Add ssm param pointing to v1 (already set) 3) During maintenance, apply role v2 + update param to v2 but don't flip release pipeline yet 4) Run auth smoke + if green, flip pipeline alias 5) Monitor for 15m then retire v1.
deploy-bot: notice: default canary_duration=10m. rollback_on_failure=true.
Aria: We also want a short-lived deploy-bot exception: if failure_reason contains "AssumeRoleDenied" then hold rollback for 12 minutes and emit alert with tag [iam-rollout-hold].
Connor: I can add that exception as a rule change; it only needs to be present for the maintenance window. Make it TTL 20m.
Priya: Please add a release note snippet and public PR blurb: "Planned IAM role alias swap to reduce cross-account surface. Temporary canary rollback hold for AssumeRoleDenied during verification."
Aria: I'll own the terraform apply and release notes. Connor you own deploy-bot exception and SSM param promotion script. Priya you'll run the smoke auth checks.
Connor: One more: ensure deploy job logs include the alias value (redacted) so we can correlate failures to param value.
Priya: Also set a metric alert: if assume role error rate > 10% across canaries post-flip, auto-demote the ssm param and trigger rollback.
deploy-bot: note: exceptions will still forward alerts to #ops-oncall.
Aria: Rollback criteria spelled out: - immediate rollback if non-auth functional failures occur during canary - if only AssumeRoleDenied appears AND rate < 10% then hold and investigate - if AssumeRoleDenied rate >= 10% or persists beyond 12m, demote param and abort release.
Connor: I'll put the deploy-bot change request with the TTL and add @ops-oncall for awareness.
Priya: After apply I'll run: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn $(aws ssm get-parameter --name /infra/deploy/role-v --query Parameter.Value --output text) --role-session-name smoke` and report pass/fail.
Aria: Timeline: release at 22:30 UTC, maintenance apply 23:00 UTC. Exception window 22:50-23:10 UTC. Smoke checks 23:00-23:12. Flip pipeline 23:15 if green. Demote at 23:30 if problems.
Connor: ACK. I'll post the change request and include terraform plan screenshot in the thread.
Priya: I'll prepare a short runbook for support: commands to demote ssm param and how to force a rollback.
Aria: Thanks team. I'll post a final readiness note 30m before maintenance.
